# Tender response -- KESKIJKAU-2026-0143

Visakoivu Oy, Jyvaskyla -- technical property maintenance framework agreement

## 3. Eligibility

3.1 Visakoivu Oy holds a valid LUSA competence certificate for the relevant field.

3.3 Visakoivu's equity ratio for the most recent financial year exceeds the minimum threshold set out in Section 3.

3.4 Visakoivu's turnover exceeds the minimum threshold set out in Section 3.

## 4. Technical requirements

4.1 Corrective maintenance response times: critical faults within 4 hours, non-critical within 24 hours.

4.2 Refrigeration and cooling-plant servicing is carried out by F-kaasu certified technicians in accordance with the F-gas regulation.

4.3 Subcontracted work is governed by our standard subcontractor management plan: approval, insurance and qualification checks, and retained supervisory responsibility.

4.4 The property asset register and maintenance documentation are handed over to the City in an agreed digital format at contract end.

4.5 Proposed SLA targets: 95% of critical faults resolved within the response window, reported monthly.

4.6 New or modified plant is commissioned against a written test protocol, witnessed by the City's property management unit.

4.7 Condition-monitoring data is collected via our maintenance management system and made available to the City on request.

4.8 All deployed technicians hold the qualifications required for their trade.

4.9 Our staff observe the City's access-control and site-security procedures at each property.

## 5. Commercial terms

5.1 Pricing is quoted in EUR.

5.3 A cost breakdown is provided in accordance with the required format.

5.4 We accept a contractual penalty for service levels not met.

## 6. Forms and attachments

6.1 CVs of key personnel are enclosed.

6.2 An extract from the Trade Register is enclosed.

## 7. Submission format

7.1 Maintenance pricing is quoted per property.

7.3 The framework pricing reference currency is EUR.

7.4 This tender is submitted ahead of the deadline of 19 October 2026, 12:00 EET.

## Liite A -- Tekninen erittely

2.1 Proposed energy-efficiency measures include monitoring plant run-times against occupancy and flagging inefficient operation for corrective action.

2.2 Unresolved faults are escalated to a named supervisor after 24 hours and to management after 48 hours.

2.3 Quality control and testing follow our NMSB 7310:2015 quality management system.

2.4 A preventive maintenance plan is prepared per property in the first quarter of the contract.

3.2 Visakoivu maintains a round-the-clock (24/7) fault-response duty rota covering all properties under this framework, staffed within Finland, consistent with our existing standby arrangements on comparable public-sector maintenance contracts.

## Liite B -- Lomakkeet ja kaupalliset ehdot

1.1 The applicable retention percentage is confirmed in the pricing schedule.

2.1 A description of our quality management system (NMSB 7310:2015) is enclosed.

2.2 This tender is submitted using the required tender form (Liite 1), completed in full.
